title: Architecture inside the mirage: evaluating generative image models on architectural style, elements, and typologies
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the architectural accuracy and stylistic fidelity of generative image models. While it includes religious buildings (e.g., Byzantine churches, Gothic cathedrals) in its dataset, they are evaluated purely on structural and ornamental grounds (e.g., arches, vaults, domes) rather than religious, moral, or ethical considerations.
